final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT a.link_to_member, m.position, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position), totals AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM grouped) SELECT g.link_to_member, g.position, g.group_count, CAST(g.group_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
